correctness.rationale: Under synchronous coupling, differences obey P_U(x-x′). Spherical fourth moment E(U^Tv)^4=3||v||^4/[d(d+2)] gives exact W4 contraction alpha=(d²-1)/(d(d+2))<1 for d>=2. The transition has bounded fourth moment and a unique invariant measure; rotational covariance of the update yields isotropy, EX=0 (even if EY != 0 because EU=0). Orthogonality ||P_U X+YU||²=||P_U X||²+Y² gives stationary M2=d sigma² and M4=d(d+2)[2(d-1)sigma⁴+mu4]/(2d+1). Isotropy converts M4 into the coordinate formula. Conditional expectation E[X_{n+1}|X_n]=(1-1/d)X_n yields lag covariance and the geometric summation factor 2d-1. Independent rational checks for dimensions 2..200 confirm algebra, not universal theorem. No Gaussian limit or CLT is inferred.
